# Nehemiah Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 472v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_010_page_001.jpg

---

**10:1** And-upon the-sealed [ha-chatumim] [documents were]: Nechemyah the-Tirshata son of-Chakhalyah, and-Tsidqiyyah,

**10:2** Serayah, Azaryah, Yirmeyah, **10:3** Pashchur, Amaryah, Malkiyyah, **10:4** Chattush, Shevanyah, Mallukh, **10:5** Charim, Meremot, Ovadyah, **10:6** Dani'el, Ginneton, Barukh, **10:7** Meshullam, Aviyyah, Miyyamin, **10:8** Ma'azyah, Bilgay, Shemayah. These [were] the-priests [ha-kohanim].

**10:9** And-the-Levi'im: Yeshua son of-Azanyah, Binnuy of-the-sons of-Chenadad, Qadmi'el. **10:10** And-their-brothers: Shevanyah, Hodiyyah, Qelita, Pelayah, Chanan, **10:11** Mikha, Rechov, Chashavyah, **10:12** Zakkur, Sherevyah, Shevanyah, **10:13** Hodiyyah, Bani, Beninu.

**10:14** The-heads of-the-people [rashey ha-am]: Par'osh, Pachat-Mo'av, Eilam, Zattu, Bani, **10:15** Bunni, Azgad, Bevay, **10:16** Adoniyyah, Bigvay, Adin, **10:17** Ater, Chizkiyyah, Azzur, **10:18** Hodiyyah, Chashum, Betsay, **10:19** Charif, Anatot, Nevay, **10:20** Magpi'ash, Meshullam, Chezir, **10:21** Meshezav'el, Tsadoq, Yaddua, **10:22** Pelatyah, Chanan, Anayah, **10:23** Hoshe'a, Chananyah, Chashshuv, **10:24** ha-Lochesh, Pilcha, Shoveq, **10:25** Rechum, Chashavnah, Ma'aseyah, **10:26** Achiyyah, Chanan, Anan, **10:27** Mallukh, Charim, Ba'anah.

**10:28** And-the-rest of-the-people, the-priests, the-Levi'im, the-gatekeepers, the-singers, the-Netinim, and-all who-separated-themselves [ha-nivdalim] from-the-peoples of-the-lands to the-Torah of-God [el Torat ha-Elohim], their-wives [nesheyhem], their-sons [beneyhem], and-their-daughters [u-venoteyhem], all who-know [yode'a] [and] understand [mevin] —

**10:29** they-are-joining [machaziqim] with their-brothers [acheyhem], their-nobles [addireyhem], and-entering into-a-curse [alah] and-into-an-oath [u-vi-shevu'ah] to-walk [lalekhet] in-the-Torah of-God which was-given [nittenah] by-the-hand of-Mosheh the-servant of-God, and-to-keep [lishmor] and-to-do [ve-la'asot] all the-commandments [mitsvot] of-YHWH our-Lord and-his-judgments [u-mishpatav] and-his-statutes [ve-chuqqav].

**10:30** And-that we-will-not give [lo nitten] our-daughters to-the-peoples of-the-land [le-ammey ha-arets] and-their-daughters we-will-not take for-our-sons.

**10:31** And-the-peoples of-the-land who-bring [ha-mevi'im] wares [meqqachot] and-all grain [shever] on-the-Sabbath day [be-yom ha-Shabbat] to-sell [limkor] — we-will-not buy [lo niqqach] from-them on-the-Sabbath and-on-a-holy day [yom qodesh]. And-we-will-let-drop [ve-nittosh] the-seventh year [ha-shanah ha-shevi'it] and-the-loan [mashsha] of-every hand.

**10:32** And-we-established [ve-he'emadnu] upon ourselves commandments [mitsvot] to-give a-third of-a-shekel [shelishit ha-sheqel] yearly [ba-shanah] for-the-service [la-avodat] of-the-house of-our-God:

**10:33** for-the-bread [lechem] of-the-arrangement [ha-ma'arekhet] and-the-continual grain-offering [minchat ha-tamid] and-the-continual burnt-offering [olat ha-tamid], the-Sabbaths [ha-Shabbatot], the-new-moons [ha-chodashim], the-appointed-times [la-mo'adim], and-the-holy-things [ve-la-qodashim] and-the-sin-offerings [ve-la-chattat] to-atone [le-khapper] for Yisra'el, and-all the-work [melekhet] of-the-house of-our-God.

**10:34** And-the-lots [ha-goralot] we-cast [hippalnu] concerning the-wood offering [qurban ha-etsim], the-priests, the-Levi'im, and-the-people, to-bring [le-havi] to-the-house of-our-God, by-the-houses of-our-fathers [le-veyt avotenu], at-appointed times [le-ittim] year by-year [shanah be-shanah], to-burn [le-va'er] upon the-altar [mizbe'ach] of-YHWH our-God, as-it-is-written in-the-Torah.

**10:35** And-to-bring the-firstfruits [bikkurey] of-our-ground [admatenu] and-the-firstfruits of-all fruit [peri] of-every tree [kol ets], year by-year, to-the-house of-YHWH.

**10:36** And-the-firstborn [bekhorot] of-our-sons and-our-livestock [behemtenu], as-it-is-written in-the-Torah, and-the-firstborn of-our-cattle [beqarenu] and-our-flocks [tsonenu] to-bring to-the-house of-our-God, to-the-priests who-minister [ha-mesharetim] in-the-house of-our-God.

**10:37** And-the-first [reshit] of-our-dough [arisotenu] and-our-contributions [terumotenu] and-the-fruit of-every tree, new-wine [tirosh] and-fresh-oil [yitshar], we-will-bring to-the-priests, to-the-chambers [lishkhot] of-the-house of-our-God, and-the-tithe [ma'aser] of-our-ground to-the-Levi'im; and-they, the-Levi'im, are-the-ones-receiving-tithes [ha-me'asserim] in-all the-cities of-our-labor [avodatenu].

**10:38** And-the-priest, a-son of-Aharon, shall-be with the-Levi'im when-the-Levi'im receive-tithes [ba-asser ha-Levi'im], and-the-Levi'im shall-bring-up [ya'alu] a-tithe of-the-tithe [ma'aser ha-ma'aser] to-the-house of-our-God, to-the-chambers [la-leshakhot], to-the-treasury-house [le-veyt ha-otsar].

**10:39** For to-the-chambers shall-bring the-sons of-Yisra'el and-the-sons of-Levi the-contribution [terumat] of-the-grain [ha-dagan], the-new-wine [ha-tirosh] and-the-fresh-oil [ve-ha-yitshar], and-there [are] the-vessels [kelei] of-the-sanctuary [ha-miqdash] and-the-priests who-minister and-the-gatekeepers and-the-singers. And-we-will-not neglect [lo na'azov] the-house of-our-God.

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **10:1 "the sealed documents"** — The list of signatories establishes this as a formal legal document, binding the community through representative leaders from all social classes.
2. **10:31 "let drop the seventh year"** — A commitment to observe the sabbatical year (*shemittah*), including release of debts, as prescribed in Deuteronomy 15:1-3.
3. **10:32 "a third of a shekel"** — Different from the half-shekel tax of Exodus 30:13; this may reflect the economic hardship of the post-exilic community, which could not afford the full amount.
4. **10:39 "we will not neglect the house of our God"** — The chapter's closing declaration; this pledge becomes the standard against which Nehemiah judges the community's faithfulness in chapter 13.

*— EMET*
